discoveryRaw.title: 4 Exercises to Fix Back Pain From Sitting All Day

metadataRaw.title: 4 Exercises to Fix Back Pain From Sitting All Day
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that will help quickly improve back pain from sitting all day.

Over time, too much sitting can lead to a sedentary lifestyle that causes tightness and weakness to build in the muscles that support the back. This makes the back more susceptible to injury and pain.

To help fix this, this video will go over 4 exercises that will focus on lengthening and strengthening these muscles for both quick and long last relief.

Great part is, you can do them all seated and throughout the day. 

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:33 Lower Back and Hips
4:23 Upper Back and Shoulders
6:00 Decompression Exercise
7:49 Strengthening Exercise
